args.text: Can you start a short Sev 1 recap for Thea's exec call: when the Superior sync broke on 4 Nov, who found the cause, and when it was resolved. Post it here as a draft.

DRAFT – Sev 1 recap for Thea's exec call (from #inc-qfl-sev1, 4 Nov 2025)

• What broke: the dock schedule sync for Quarrendon Freight Lines at their Superior terminal. Dana flagged it at 07:02 AM, with the start put at about 6:40 AM Quarrendon time. Yard tablets were spinning and drivers were backing up at the guard shack.
• Who found the cause: Samir Patel (on-call). At 07:17 AM he identified a deadlocked webhook listener on the QFL tenant as the culprit. (His first lead, a 06:30 UTC deployment, was only a hypothesis; the incident room doesn't confirm it as the cause.)
• Interim: Thea joined a bridge for about 20 minutes. Samir cleared the stuck jobs and Superior got a partial sync around 8:15 AM, though some inbound trailers were still duplicating.
• Resolved: Samir's hotfix was deployed and the replay script finished at 02:38 PM, with all Superior dock schedules syncing cleanly in real time. Dana closed the incident at 02:44 PM after Thea confirmed from the yard.

To confirm before it goes out: the room doesn't give a time zone for the posted times, so I've left them as written. The postmortem notes aren't in anything I can see, so there's no formal root cause or follow-ups yet. Dana, edit freely.

Dana, I've posted the recap draft in #north-team. I built it from #inc-qfl-sev1, which you're in. The incident was on 4 Nov 2025 at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

- **Who found the cause:** Samir Patel, at 07:17 AM. He found a deadlocked webhook listener on the QFL tenant. His earlier guess, a 06:30 UTC deployment, was never confirmed as the cause.
- **Resolved:** Superior got a partial sync around 8:15 AM. Samir's hotfix and replay script finished at 02:38 PM, and you closed the incident at 02:44 PM.

Two gaps to check before it goes to Thea:
- The room doesn't say which time zone the posted times are in, so I left them as written.
- I couldn't find any postmortem notes, so the draft has no formal root cause or follow-ups.

Picking up Dana's recap: add that the culprit was a deadlocked webhook listener and that Thea was on the bridge for about twenty minutes, then put 30 minutes on the calendar for Dana and me tomorrow at 10:00 to walk through it.
